north_star: Turn document review into a fast, inspectable path from evidence to the smallest useful next action while keeping consequential authority outside the model.

achieved.title: End-to-end document intake, extraction, versioned rules and evidence states
Human approval boundary, prompt-injection detection and bounded agent workflow
Tenant-scoped Postgres production shape and idempotent uploads

current.title: Prove reviewer-quality performance on representative cases
current.outcome: Move from controlled-production engineering candidate to evidence that qualified reviewers can trust the findings, next actions and hand-offs on representative work.

next.title: Run a qualified-reviewer accuracy and correction study
next.why: The biggest remaining product claim is reviewer usefulness and accuracy on representative cases.

next.title: Exercise one real DMS/Fachverfahren-style integration path
next.why: The workflow should prove it can fit the target operating environment rather than remain a standalone demo.

next.title: Define and measure operating SLOs plus deployment security/privacy acceptance
next.why: Production readiness requires environment-specific evidence, not an engineering flag.
